prompt: Ink and watercolor illustration: confident brush-pen linework, loose wet-in-wet indigo washes for the sky and the mist, granulating pigment texture, warm ochre touches for the windows, visible paper grain. Like a page from the sketchbook of a fantasy cartographer. Wide panoramic night landscape seen from high on a dark rocky ridge, looking down a valley towards the sea. Layout, from left to right: on the far left, one large mountain slope with fog on it. In the centre of the image there are NO mountains in the distance at all: the valley opens onto the open ocean, a wide calm sea that fills the centre all the way to a flat, straight horizon line under the night sky, with moonlight glittering on the water. A river starts at the town and winds down the middle of the valley, widening into an estuary that flows out into the ocean. On the right, a few hills next to the wall. The town sits at the foot of the wall and fills the ground right up against its base: houses, roofs and warm lit windows touch the wall, and there is absolutely no water, no canal and no river between the town and the wall. The colossal ancient wall on the right is built of enormous fitted stone blocks with clearly drawn joints, its top one clean continuous edge with nothing standing on it, broken only where it is bitten away and erased, with stone fragments drifting up like dust. High in the sky on the left, a pale moon with a big chunk bitten out of it, crumbling into specks. Starry sky. The bottom fifth of the image is the dark, empty crest of the ridge we stand on, with short grass and a few rocks, with no buildings or figures on it. No people. Avoid: text, letters, captions, signature, watermark, frame, border, photorealism, 3D render, glossy digital painting, saturated colors, neon, anime style, gore
